visualBrief.coreEventZh: 把长文本工作台从零散拼凑收回到按需整理的一次整体收口。
visualBrief.keyActionZh: 把多余的分类与多余副本一一清掉,只留下按需整理的核心工位。
visualBrief.resultZh: 方案抽象为「表达任务 + 输出偏好」并已在隔离候选中验证通过,视觉规范铺到多个桌面页面。
visualBrief.tensionZh: 最后一公里尚未走完,真实场景下的完整流程仍待连续验证。
visualBrief.industrialMetaphorZh: 19 世纪印刷工坊里,排字工把散落的字盘归拢,只留下最常用的一套活字与一台样张打样机。
supportingSymbolsZh: 正在归拢活字盘的主排字工
封好样张的完整印样,版面未破损
仍敞着等待最后一道工序的印样夹
visualBrief.sceneDescriptionZh: 一间偏暗的印刷工坊内,一束顶光从高处斜照在中央的工作台;背景只见木架、纸卷与几束斜阳,不再出现多余物件。
focalElementsEn: a typesetter gathering scattered type cases into one neat tray
a sealed proof sheet kept intact on the workbench
an open proof folder still awaiting its final run
visualBrief.imagePromptEn: A 19th-century print workshop under one overhead skylight. A typesetter at a wooden bench gathers scattered type cases into a single aligned tray, one hand steadying the frame. To his right, a sealed proof sheet lies flat, unbroken and complete. Beyond his left, an open proof folder waits with blank inner sheets. Warm wood, quiet air, only these three elements in frame.
